shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular slab/pillar
small subsidiary figure(s) placed low near the base
repeated small rectangular units forming a band/grid of signs
justification: Both are flat slabs with shallow relief organised in stacked zones, containing profile animals, small crouching subsidiary figures near the base and a block of repeated rectangular sign-like units, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is dominated by purely animal imagery (row of arched crouching beasts, quadrupeds, a large long-necked bird) with no human presence, whereas B centres on a large frontal/three-quarter human figure in elaborate headdress and costume holding an object, an entirely different subject and compositional focus.
